body:
📒 *known issue recurrence* — `ki-2026-07-04-crm-amqp-consumer-monitor-family-quiet-period-flap`
This is occurrence #20 in the last 7 days (139 all-time). (DD-scan-diff synthetic — no Slack MCP this session.)
Owning team (would tag — not tagged): `CRM Experience` (`@customer-management` / `#team-customer-management`)
Playbook: 1) Confirm shape: monitor ID is one of the 5 sibling AMQP-consumer monitors, name matches '[CRM] <service> throughput dropped (possible stall)' or '[CRM] <service> heartbeat — consumer silent'. 2) Pull `scripts/dd_search.py metric --query 'sum:trace.amqp.command.hits{service:<name>,env:prod}.as_rate()'` over a multi-hour window — expect a genuine but brief dip below the monitor's floor, not a data gap/tool failure. 3) Confirm `service:<name> status:error` in DD Logs returns 0 for the window. 4) Check sibling outbound-5xx/P95-latency monitors for the same service — if also OK throughout, this is the benign quiet-period pattern. 5) Escalate only if unresolved after ~1h or a sibling error/latency monitor co-fires. 6) Do not re-investigate from scratch on each recurrence.
Open Jira: n/a — no fix_jira on this entry (fix_status: monitoring-noise-suspected-unconfirmed)

Source alerts (1 total, DD-scan-diff synthetic — no Slack MCP this session):
  • monitor 302055141, last_triggered 2026-08-19T08:03:21Z (OK, recovered by scan time)

Root-cause analysis:
  • Query: `dd_search.py metric --query 'sum:trace.amqp.command.hits{service:method-mobile-notifications-subscriber,env:prod}.as_rate()'`, window 2026-08-19T06:00:00Z–09:00:00Z
  • Observed: genuine ~76-minute data gap 06:44Z→08:00Z (consumer effectively silent), throughput resumes to 0.03–0.23 msg/s by 08:00–08:59Z; overall_state_modified 08:03:21Z is 3 min after traffic resumed; 0 hits on `service:method-mobile-notifications-subscriber status:error` for the full window
  • Reasoning: matches the documented benign quiet-period trip-then-recover shape — no corroborating error, consistent with the 5-sibling-monitor family's chronic pattern

Evidence:
  • DD monitor: https://app.datadoghq.com/monitors/302055141 (state: OK, recovered)
  • DD metric: https://app.datadoghq.com/metric/explorer?live=false&page=0&exp_metric=trace.amqp.command.hits&exp_scope=service%3Amethod-mobile-notifications-subscriber%2Cenv%3Aprod&exp_agg=avg&start=1755583200&end=1755593400
  • DD logs (0-hit error check): https://app.datadoghq.com/logs?query=service%3Amethod-mobile-notifications-subscriber%20status%3Aerror&from_ts=1755583200000&to_ts=1755593400000&live=false
  • This-window concentration: n/a — single-service AMQP-consumer monitor, no per-service ES breakdown applicable (evidence_source: datadog_apm)
